source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Ending and credits: tender at first, remembering the whole journey, then warm and triumphant, a broad closing statement of the main theme, full of gratitude. Tempo 72 BPM, 4/4 time, key of G major. Instrumentation: music box and harp opening, solo flute, full orchestra in the middle, strings and horns, gentle timpani, cymbal swells. Form: quiet music-box opening, theme on flute, orchestral build, triumphant full restatement, warm coda that can loop back to the theme. Duration: 150 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
